status: Resizable complete at assigned native/Lit boundary; M14 complete
implementation: Keyed percentage layout, bounded normalization, immutable complete snapshots and independent collapsed state
Adjacent-pair pointer/keyboard resizing with previous-size restoration and application-owned persistence
Native separator orientation, accessible naming and element-reference controls; focus recovery before hiding content
Shared state/ownership helpers and public Lit Motion interpolation; direct manipulation jumps to the canonical endpoint
Retained author nodes, nested layouts and Scroll Area composition; cancellation/adoption/resize cleanup
Reduced-motion document producer now disables transition/animation durations and delays instead of introducing micro transitions
